LHX.sentence: L3Harris has fallen hard and is sitting right near its lowest price of the year, which is unusually beaten-down for a big defense contractor with a record pile of orders waiting to be filled — nothing about the business seems broken.

ASML.sentence: ASML ticked up a touch, and as their earnings recover the stock actually looks less expensive than the 'this is all hype' crowd would have you believe — they're still the only company on earth making a certain essential chipmaking machine.

LIN.sentence: Linde is having a flat, quiet week — the industrial gas business just steadily ticks along, and it's rare to see this best-in-class operator priced no higher than its peers.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft has been treading water lately while similar companies climbed, but the cloud-and-AI story keeps grinding along without any real drama.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher is near its high for the year, and biotech funding is thawing in a way that usually means more lab-equipment orders a couple of quarters out — though a lot of that good news may already be in the price.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is essentially flat and pays a healthy dividend, doing exactly what this oil-and-gas pipeline toll-road business is supposed to do — nothing surprising.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow slipped a bit and is well off its high, but big companies and government agencies keep signing up for its workflow-automation and AI-assistant tools on long-term contracts.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore edged up and is holding up slightly better than copper itself, thanks to its trading arm — it mines copper, cobalt and nickel and also profits when commodity markets swing around.

MLM.sentence: Martin Marietta dipped a little, but the price it gets for a ton of crushed stone is still climbing steadily — the moat that lets each quarry quietly raise prices year after year is fully intact.

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA is quiet, and a strong Mexican peso is helping since most of its earnings are in pesos that get converted back for U.S. investors.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras is generating enormous cash while oil prices are high and its costs to pump are low, though such rich earnings rarely last forever — this is a good stretch for it.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the Danish container-shipping giant, is up modestly and is trading for less than it would cost to build its fleet of ships from scratch — essentially buying the steel at a discount.

MA.sentence: Mastercard is basically flat, and unusually it's priced just a hair cheaper than its twin Visa, when it normally trades at a premium — people keep tapping their cards more than ever.

ISRG.sentence: The da Vinci surgical robot maker had a good day, and while it's still priced well below its own recent history, hospitals keep performing more operations — and each one means more disposable instruments sold.
